devices.description: Routers to ask. Omit to ask every configured router that is not disabled.

listen_seconds.description: Also listen for MikroTik discovery (MNDP, UDP 5678) on the MCP host itself for this many seconds. Finds devices on the host's own network segment, also with no managed router.

scan.description: Also scan a subnet from one router (`/tool ip-scan`). Finds hosts that announce nothing, by address and MAC. It sends probes on that network.

device.description: The router that runs the scan

interface.description: Scan the subnet on this interface
